stops.name: Parque natural de Tamadaba
stops.detail: The Tamadaba or Tamadaba pine Natural Park is a protected natural space situated between the municipalities of Artenara, Agaete and La Aldea de San Nicolás, in the north-west of Gran Canaria Island (Canary Islands). It was declared a natural park by the Act of Declaration of Natural Spaces of the Canary Islands on June 19, 1987. Also, since July 7, [dated source], the cultural landscape of the Fairy Risco and sacred mountains of Gran Canaria, called UNESCO World Heritage, includes some of this protected space.
